arguments.task: Audit a TYPO3 project and its sitepackage for problems, risks and missing safeguards

outcomes.evidence: Everything but the surfaces came first. The skill and its base, checklist and report were calls 1-4. typo3_project_describe, typo3_extension_describe for both extensions and typo3_task_guide with changeType audit followed at 15:57:38-43. The brief carried `surfaces` with seven entries and their hint ids. Eleven seconds later the session started the declared checks and read the checkout, at calls 10 and 11. No text stands before that read. The first text, at 15:58:00, names the files it reads next and no surface. The surfaces appear only in the closing Surfaces table, the 'after it' the criterion names. The instruction that goes with the list, TaskGuide::SURFACES_OWED, stands in the text half of the answer. The transcript holds the data half alone and contains 'Surfaces: write this list' nowhere, which is D-EVI-011's measurement holding. This is the third REVIEW-01 run in a row with this miss.

Each of the nine findings carries Where, Observed, Rule, Consequence, Remediation, Owner and Evidence in that order. The checkout confirms the spot-checked claims. Header.html:9,16,23,30,37,44 wrap `{header -> events:format.highlightWords()}` in ``, and Connect.html:6 prints `href="{speaker.website}"`. deployment.yml runs on push to master with no needs. additional.php:53 reads `getenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') ?? ''`. ext_icon.png has no Extension.svg beside it, and 13.0 removed that location after Deprecation-98093. Finding 1 is verified by a render through ddev exec php (call 20) that printed `` unescaped. One detail is off again. Finding 2 dates the key to f41998c of 2023-06-30. git log -S with the key's value over all paths finds e287c12 of 2018-12-12, because the session again restricted the search to the renamed settings.php.

The order is consequence. The stored XSS any editor can place on every site and the committed production key stand under High. The unsafe .env.dist fallback, the ungated deploy, the save that a Google failure aborts and the javascript: link come under Medium. Rector drift, the version range and the toolchain pins stand under Low. Finding 6 ranks below finding 1 with its reason, 'it needs a click'. Rector's 12 files rank by what CI misses, not by their count.

The conventions came after the judgment. The session proved the XSS from vendor/typo3fluid/fluid AbstractViewHelper.php at call 19 and the render at call 20, at 15:59:17-27. The first typo3_hint_lookup came at 16:00:17, after 15 reads, under the text 'Next: the convention lookups for each surface'. The three lookups took ids from the brief's surface list rather than a finding as the query, which is new. They covered Security, Quality, Persistence and part of Package and Pinned versions. Registration and runtime and Rendering got no lookup, so fluid-templates, site-sets, tsconfig, language-files and public-assets were never asked. The security-sinks answer carried the new f:format.raw statement, and finding 1 cites it as its Rule. The verdict on the XSS is right this time, and the session kept it at High. The absent surfaces now show: Rendering's TypoScript, TSconfig and XLF and the TCA of the own tables stand as unassessed rows. No runtime lookup ran, and Not reached says so.

The kinds stay apart under the report's headings. High to Low hold defects with an Evidence line marked verified or reasoned. Recommendation holds the docs, the icon, the redundant ext_tables.sql, the finally block and the getenv fallback. Open holds four questions with what would settle each. Dropped holds three disproved candidates with their source. Checked and correct holds eight claims that held. The key, the env fallback and the deployment pins carry Owner unassigned, which marks them as operations no TYPO3 workflow here owns.

The report ends on Not reached, then a six-step order with the skill for each. The last line asks which of these to work on, and on which branch. The session changed no file. Every finding names its owner: typo3-content-element-development, typo3-extension-testing, typo3-extension-upgrade, typo3-extension-asset-build or unassigned. Nine findings and five recommendations stay within review. The three-sentence summary before the fence breaks report.md's rule, which is a form defect rather than started work.

failures.evidence: No finding is a TYPO3 checklist item without a place in this checkout. Each names a file of site-events or a value a call returned for it. The two sitepackage hints that opened the brief's list, under the weak intent 'sitepackage', left no mark on the report.

The missing tests stand inside finding 4 with the ungated deploy, as the reason a broken change reaches production. The docs and the icon stand under Recommendation. The env fallback is labelled with what would confirm it under Open. The DataHandler TypeError candidate was dropped after the session read DataHandler.php:719.

typo3_ter_lookup returned empty, and the session read it as a path-repository package rather than a missing release. The runtime lookups it skipped stand under Not reached with the lookups they would be. The production .env it could not read goes to Open, not to a verdict.

Every check it ran is the project's own composer script, t3g:cgl, t3g:phpstan and t3g:rector, under DDEV, as typo3_project_describe declared them. No core command or core process appears. One remediation again says to confirm the key with typo3_configuration_lookup, which reads the local installation only and not production.

git status in site-events was clean on develop at 1123b1e before and after the run. The transcript carries no Edit or Write. The three checks are dry runs by their composer definitions. The rector reruns at calls 15 and 16 pass --dry-run, and the render read its template from stdin. Call 34 ran git fetch --prune, which updates remote-tracking refs in .git and no file of the checkout.

notes: Session ff4d1f81-fba9-4353-81de-f6ce6ad99c68, 2026-10-28 15:57:23-16:02:26 UTC by its transcript, claude-opus-5-5. It ran with --permission-mode acceptEdits and allowedTools Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, Skill and mcp__typo3-dev-companion. The server start refreshed the stale published skills, and the published SKILL.md, checklist and report match this checkout. The maintainer started the DDEV project events-site right before the run, and site-events was clean on develop at 1123b1e before and after it. 35 tool calls, 9 to this server, and the skill activated at the first call. The run it replaces is in commit c0768e3b (session c7442365-485d-40bc-ab0e-cfda7b43aad9, server c0a078b7), with the same two criteria missed. Four changes met their first run here. The f:format.raw statement in security-sinks reached the session and stands as finding 1's Rule. The session had proved the XSS from the Fluid source and a render before it asked. typo3_task_guide carried the surface list in its data half, and the session used its ids for three lookups. The instruction to write the list before the first read stands in the text half, which Claude Code does not hand the model (D-EVI-011). D-SCO-017 holds: the brief placed composer.json, config/sites and .ddev/config.yaml in scope project, and the hint lookups placed config/system/additional.php, .env.dist, ci.yml, phpstan.neon and rector.php there too. The brief's top-level scope still says extension for three project paths of five. The report rules of 90b38fc4 hold in part. Checked and correct, Open and Dropped now keep the em dash, and Surfaces splits a partly read surface into an unassessed row. The Package and Range head fields still carry parentheses, and a summary stands before the fence. Findings 2 and 3 name typo3_hint_lookup for project-configuration-files, which typo3_task_guide answered. What the run teaches beyond this repository is three things. The surface instruction has to reach the data half to reach Claude Code. The hint lookups still come after the reading, now by the right ids. A git log -S on the renamed settings.php dated the key five years late in two runs.
